description: This file is a test script for the 'git blame' command, verifying its output in various formats and scenarios. It sets up a git repository, makes commits, and checks the output of blame commands against expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful completion.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test timer to simulate time passing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
